s: Allah raises the heavens, orders the sun and moon, spreads out the earth, sends water, shows lightning, and causes thunder to hymn His praise. He knows the visible and invisible, guides whom He wills, forgives, punishes, and is the Creator of all things.

l: Muhammad, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Muhammad is addressed as a warner and messenger who recites what Allah has inspired in him. He is commanded to serve Allah alone, reject partners, trust in Him, and proclaim that Allah is his Lord.

l: the Scripture, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The Scripture contains verses revealed from Allah to Muhammad, and what is revealed from his Lord is described as the Truth. Those with knowledge of the Scripture are presented as witnesses.

l: the earth, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The earth is spread out with firm hills, flowing streams, neighbouring tracts, vineyards, ploughed lands, and date-palms. Allah reduces its outlying parts and sends water that makes its valleys flow.

l: mankind, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Most of mankind do not believe despite the revelation and Allah's signs. Allah is rich in pardon for mankind despite their wrong.

l: the Fire, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The Fire is the abode of those who disbelieve, who will abide therein.

l: those who disbelieve, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Those who disbelieve reject Muhammad's messengership, demand a portent, dispute concerning Allah, and deny some of the revelation. They face torment in the life of the world and a more painful doom in the Hereafter, with the Fire as their reward.

l: angels, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Angels guard people before and behind them by Allah's command. They hymn Allah's praise with awe of Him and enter the heavenly Home through every gate.

l: the thunder, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The thunder hymns Allah's praise, and Allah launches thunderbolts and smites with them whom He wills while they dispute concerning Him.

l: the real prayer, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The real prayer belongs to Allah. Those prayed to beside Allah do not respond, and the prayer of disbelievers goes astray.

l: those who answered Allah's call, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Those who answered Allah's call have bliss. They are promised the heavenly Home and Gardens of Eden.

l: those who answered not His call, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Those who answered not Allah's call would offer all that is in the earth and its like as ransom, but they will have a woeful reckoning and hell as their habitation.

l: hell, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Hell is the dire abode and habitation of those who do not answer Allah's call.

l: men of understanding, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Men of understanding heed that what is revealed to Muhammad from his Lord is the truth. They keep Allah's pact, unite what Allah commands joined, persevere, pray, spend, and overcome evil with good.

l: the pact of Allah, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The pact of Allah is kept by those who heed the truth, and it is broken by those who ratify it and then sever what Allah commands joined.

l: the heavenly Home, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The heavenly Home is the sequel for those who persevere, pray, spend, and overcome evil with good. Those who break Allah's covenant have an ill abode instead.

l: Gardens of Eden, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Gardens of Eden are entered by the righteous and by those who do right among their fathers, helpmeets, and seed. Angels enter to them from every gate and greet them with peace.

l: believers, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Believers know that what is revealed to Muhammad from his Lord is the truth. They find rest in the remembrance of Allah and receive joy and a good journey's end when they do right.

That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The life of the world is a brief comfort compared with the Hereafter. Those who disbelieve may rejoice in it, but torment also reaches them in it.

l: the Hereafter, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The Hereafter has a more painful doom for those who disbelieve than the torment of the life of the world. The reward of those who keep their duty is contrasted with the Fire.

l: the remembrance of Allah, Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd), Surah 13: The Thunder (Ar-Ra'd) / 1 Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: The remembrance of Allah gives rest to the hearts of those who have believed.

That which is revealed unto t .. 43 They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
s: Allah guides unto Himself all who turn unto Him and sends whom He wills astray. Those whom Allah sends astray have no guide.
